placements.title: Analytics infrastructure choices are architecture decisions
placements.theme: Database platform selection for the analytics pipeline is an architecture-level decision with lasting performance and cost consequences, not a routine tooling swap.

Nothing existing in this fresh repo covers this theme, so it is minted fresh under the newly-minted Architecture stratum, matching the position-pass grouping of src-1/2/3/4 as one directional read on what justifies the move.
placements.title: Analytics database migration decision
placements.theme: The analytics pipeline's database moves from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB because the switch delivers materially better query performance at lower licensing cost.
